verdict.rationale: Fathom documents its own meeting capture and recording, with unlimited recordings and transcriptions and a choice of bot-free (beta) or bot capture. That choice gives some control over how meetings are recorded. However, nothing in the pack names Zoom, Google Meet, or Microsoft Teams, and nothing evidences reliability. Missing for 10: explicit Zoom/Google Meet/Microsoft Teams platform support, controls over which meetings get recorded, evidence of capture reliability, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Choice of bot-free (in beta) or bot capture
